label: Housing approvals
description: Monthly number of new residential dwelling building approvals issued by local councils — a leading indicator of future housing supply.
explainer: Building approvals lead actual construction by 12–18 months, making this a useful forward indicator of housing supply. Australia needs approximately 240,000 new homes per year to meet population growth and the government's Housing Accord target — recent approvals have consistently fallen short. When approvals collapse (as in 2023 due to construction cost pressures), a supply shortage follows 1–2 years later.
projection_source: HIA and Master Builders Australia housing forecasts.
